origin.note: AIHOT ships 18 public demo feeds that are imported on first start. Their URLs were taken as discovery facts only; every title, description, category, and bundle below was written for this catalog, and no AIHOT content is redistributed.

method: Every candidate endpoint was fetched directly over HTTPS and its payload parsed as RSS, Atom, or JSON Feed. Each round records the HTTP status, the parsed root format, the number of items actually read, the newest item timestamp as published by the feed, and the channel's own title and language. Candidates had to return a parseable feed with at least one item in all three rounds. Tidings parser rounds were not available in the authoring environment, so this round records HTTP fetch plus feed-parse evidence only.
timezone_note: Review timestamps are Asia/Macau (UTC+8); feed timestamps are reproduced in UTC as published.
